# appdynamics_actions (Data Source)

Lists the alert actions defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_actions" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "action_names" {
  value = { for a in data.appdynamics_actions.all.actions : a.id => a.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list actions for.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes List) The actions defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `action_type` (String) One of SMS, EMAIL, CUSTOM_EMAIL, THREAD_DUMP, HTTP_REQUEST, RUN_SCRIPT_ON_NODES, DIAGNOSE_BUSINESS_TRANSACTIONS, CREATE_UPDATE_JIRA.
- `id` (String) Action ID.
- `name` (String)
